Thanks for opening this, and for building with Video-React.

Video-React is now in security-only maintenance. Until January 2028, we'll merge priority security fixes and nothing else, so we're closing issues that aren't security reports.

Mux, which maintains Video-React, now works on [Video.js 10](https://videojs.org?utm_source=video-react) together with the teams behind Video.js, Vidstack, Plyr, and Media Chrome. Use `@videojs/react` and start with the [React installation guide](https://videojs.org/docs/guides/installation/react?utm_source=video-react). There's no Video-React-specific migration guide, but Video-React was modelled on Video.js, so the [Video.js 8 migration guide](https://videojs.org/docs/framework/react/guides/migrate-from-video-js-8?utm_source=video-react) covers the closest concepts.

**Migrating with a coding agent?** Paste the prompt from the installation guide's [AI Quickstart](https://videojs.org/docs/guides/installation/react?utm_source=video-react#ai-quickstart) section into your agent. It installs the [Video.js skill](https://github.com/videojs/skills) and plans the installation with `npx @videojs/cli agents init`.

If this still matters to you in Video.js 10, open an issue or discussion in [videojs/v10](https://github.com/videojs/v10) and link back here so we keep the context.

If this is a security vulnerability, don't add details here. Report it privately as described in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/video-react/video-react/blob/master/SECURITY.md).
